name: gather-lockup
title: Gather Lockup
description: Logo reveal in two and a half seconds. A wall of your work sits under a line of type. The line falls apart word by word, the wall cuts in to a row of four, and each slot swaps its picture and hands over to your mark and wordmark. Measured frame by frame off a reference recording.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/scenes/gather-lockup?ref=cli — 60 frames at 24fps; paints its own background. Pass 15 images, and your logo as SVG paths (logo={{ width, height, shapes }}). — 82 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
